description: Header file declaring functions and macros related to hostapd configuration file handling in a wireless LAN driver or management module.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_create
methods.description: Creates a hostapd configuration file for a specific radio interface.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_createExt
methods.description: Creates or initializes a hostapd configuration file with extended options.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_update
methods.description: Updates specific entries in the hostapd configuration file.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_setRadioConfig
methods.description: Sets radio configuration parameters in the hostapd configuration file.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_setVapConfig
methods.description: Sets virtual access point (VAP) configuration parameters.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_genConfigHash
methods.description: Generates a configuration hash string based on current configuration settings.
